errors.error_description: Used a multiplication by a power-of-two constant to scale the step (step * 256) instead of a shift, creating inefficient hardware.
Combinational always block sensitivity list excludes dir_up while it is read inside, causing simulation-synthesis mismatch.
Incomplete assignment to next_cnt in a combinational block (no else/default when gate_enable is false) infers an unintended latch.
